summary: Vendure is a modular headless commerce framework (NestJS + TypeORM) with a GraphQL shop and admin API. It persists a full catalog (Product/Variant/Option, Asset), merchandising (Collection tree, Facet, Tag), orders (Order/OrderLine/Fulfillment/Payment/Refund) with state machines, customers/users/auth with role-based permissions, inventory (StockLevel/StockLocation/StockMovement), shipping/tax/zone/region, promotions, payment methods, channels/sellers, a search index, and job/scheduled-task/job-record + settings-store persistence.
